latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Generator Online skill.

- Instantly turn text prompts or image uploads into 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPUs.
- Supports MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG files up to 200MB; works for marketers, social creators, and small businesses.
- Seamless, code-free setup: connects to the processing API and manages sessions automatically.
- Simple commands for uploading, generating, downloading videos, and checking credits or status.
- Guides users with tips, troubleshooting, and workflow examples for fast video creation without filming.
